title: Research: Risk Forecast v1 with purged walk-forward probabilities and dependent-window validation
body:
## Question and scope
Test whether unchanged Risk Signal v3 provides incremental information about future AMD/NVDA/MU price barriers. No sales, buybacks, position sizes or economic simulations. This PR is stacked on PR #6. Protocol 8b22cf4 was committed before calculating results; no REDUCE rules, bins, shrinkage or criteria were tuned on October outcomes.

## Chronological forecast design
- Frozen PR #5 data inherited through PR #6: 2021–22 October 2026; 2021–2022 training/descriptive, annual frozen probability tests in 2023–2026.
- Replay each original annual C profile on archived causal indicators for training; held-out levels/scores must match the original walk-forward outputs. 2026 remains C/sensitive.
- Fit at Jan 1 UTC using only anchors whose entire horizon has been published by that cutoff. Early barrier hits cannot admit an otherwise unfinished horizon. Exported maturity audits cover every fit.
- Targets: any future High/Low hitting +/-5/10/15% within 5/10/20 sessions, excluding the anchor candle. Separate terminal returns. Both directions may hit; first-hit chronology and same-day ambiguity/opening-gap ordering are explicit. Incomplete horizons retain partial observed bounds but null full-horizon labels.
- Eight fixed empirical models: historical, matched drawdown, matched volatility, MA50/RSI, v3 state, v3 score, joint technical, joint technical plus v3. Fixed shrinkage and LOW_SUPPORT/backoff flags; no test-based model selection.

## Dependence and inference
Calendar moving-block resampling keeps all stocks together on a sampled date, preserving overlapping windows/common shocks. 40-session blocks, 399 metric/calibration resamples, 1999 primary paired resamples; block20/60 and yearly sensitivity also exported. Metrics include Brier, log loss, tied-score ROC-AUC/noninterpolated AP, reliability, class counts, capped HAC effective N and confidence intervals.

Primary comparison: technical_plus_v3 versus technical_combined for all 18 tasks. Require Holm p<0.05 across 18, negative paired 95% Brier interval, >=1% relative Brier improvement and block-length stability. Other comparisons and score slopes remain exploratory.

## Findings
**0/18 primary tasks confirm incremental predictive advantage under the fixed criterion.** For DOWN10 within20, pooled held-out Brier scores are approximately historical 0.228, volatility 0.224, v3-state 0.231, v3-score 0.230, joint technical 0.230 and joint technical+v3 0.234 (lower is better). Added v3 has paired delta Brier +0.0046, 95% interval [+0.0017,+0.0074].

There are 2,805 reference-task observations but an effective N around 74. State frequencies are HOLD 28.7%, WATCH 31.6%, REDUCE 36.9%, CRITICAL 26.5%, with substantially overlapping block intervals. No DOWN task has a strictly positive exploratory 95% score-slope interval. This is not a monotonic forward-downside probability scale in the tested history.

Sparse conditioning matters: about 94% of reference joint-plus-v3 forecasts carry LOW_SUPPORT. These specific estimators fail to demonstrate added information; this does not prove every possible estimator lacks predictive content. First chronological error examples per stock, late-warning diagnostics and gradual-deterioration HOLD cases are included without inventing cases or treating every warning followed by growth as a proven error.

## Artifacts and validation
reports/risk-forecast-v1/ contains the requested report.md, forecast-daily.csv, calibration.csv, baseline-comparison.csv, event-analysis.csv and validation.md, plus fit audits, state/score/metric/year/block tables, outcome summaries, October censoring and reliability/distribution figures. 39,366 daily task rows, 216 frozen probability banks, 576 metric rows, 1,080 comparisons, 2,032 reliability bins and 1,447 diagnostic records. Reproduction: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m aae.research.risk_forecast_study.

Final suite: **160 tests passed, 20 subtests passed**, including 27 new forecast tests. No unresolved automated failures. Weighted/tied ROC/AP independently cross-checked against sklearn; final source/output hashes and whitespace checks pass. Exact-touch floating-point handling was corrected via scale-relative tolerance and outputs regenerated. Frozen v3 inputs and engine modules are unchanged.

## Limits
Retrospective split-adjusted prices and assumed publication times are not independently attested point-in-time vintages. Reported daily OHLC cannot reconstruct unobserved extended-hours paths. Bootstrap conditions on fitted models/history, does not include all training/model-design uncertainty and assumes imperfect regime stability. Sparse cells/rare events do not support precise confident live probabilities; irregular conditional subsets show block counts instead of invented effective N. No reserved prospective holdout, live readiness or investment-effectiveness claim.

No merge, deploy, production data changes or modifications to existing Risk Engine/Decision Engine/investment recommendations.
